name: Mail Memory
author: Robert O'Neill
description: Finds mail by what it means, not only the words in it. Search for "the plumber who said he'd come back Thursday" and Mail Memory adds the best-matching conversations, attachments included, to the search results. Needs a Mail Memory server, which indexes your mailbox with a small embedding model running on your own hardware: no mail leaves your servers.

en.connect.title: Connect Mail Memory
